hook: The Link Belt Co. plant of 1930, a sawtooth-roofed machine shop behind a Mediterranean office building.

historical_record.description: Built as the Link Belt Co. plant: a Mediterranean-style masonry office building, a concrete pattern shop, and a steel-frame, steel-clad machine shop at the rear under a sawtooth roof. It stands in the former Western Development Co. tract, subdivided around 1925 for manufacturing.
